lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Uruguay through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset contains approximately 48,700 mapped buildings with structural metadata including building type, levels, materials, and address information, representing approximately 4% of estimated total building stock based on AI-mapped estimates.
